headline.zh: 为家族企业设计传承信托
headline.en: Design succession trust for family business

scenario.zh: 客户拥有制造企业,希望为两个子女规划股权传承,需要选择信托结构并分配控制权
scenario.en: Client owns manufacturing business, wants to plan equity succession for two children with trust structure and control allocation

instruction.zh: 根据客户的控制需求和税务目标选择信托结构
instruction.en: Select trust structure based on client's control needs and tax goals

output.zh: 客户保留完全控制权,可随时修改受益人和条款,遗产认证流程简化
output.en: Client retains full control, can modify beneficiaries and terms anytime, probate simplified

output.zh: 资产移出遗产范围,多代免税传承,但客户放弃直接控制权
output.en: Assets removed from estate, multi-generation tax-free transfer, client relinquishes direct control

instruction.zh: 确定股权和收益如何在受益人之间分配
instruction.en: Determine how equity and income distribute among beneficiaries

output.zh: 两位子女各持相同投票权,共同决策,收益按参与度分配
output.en: Both children hold equal voting rights, joint decisions, income by participation level

output.zh: 长子持较多投票权负责经营,次子持较少投票权监督,收益平均分配
output.en: Eldest holds more voting for operations, younger holds less for oversight, equal income split

instruction.zh: 评估不同受托人安排下的管理连续性
instruction.en: Evaluate management continuity under different trustee arrangements

output.zh: 信托公司作受托人,中立执行条款,子女矛盾时保护企业稳定运营
output.en: Trust company as trustee, neutral execution, protects business stability during disputes

output.zh: 配偶与长子共同受托,决策更灵活,但需要明确争议解决机制
output.en: Spouse and eldest as co-trustees, flexible decisions, requires clear dispute resolution

instruction.zh: 查看推荐的信托条款要点,准备律师审核
instruction.en: Review recommended trust provisions, prepare for attorney review

output.zh: 企业股权、不动产、金融资产分类列明,建议专业估值时间表
output.en: Business equity, real estate, financial assets categorized, professional valuation schedule suggested

output.zh: 投票权、分红权、退出机制、继承条件逐项列明,触发事件定义清晰
output.en: Voting rights, dividends, exit mechanisms, succession conditions itemized with clear triggers

takeaway.zh: Veros将复杂信托规划拆解为结构化决策流程,推荐条款框架,为律师审核和执行提供基础
takeaway.en: Veros breaks complex trust planning into structured decisions, recommends term frameworks for attorney review and execution
